evidence.notes: Digest evidence covers MD5, SHA-1/SHA1, SHA-256/SHA256, SHA-384/SHA384, SHA-512/SHA512, SHA3-256/384/512, case tolerance, and rejected spaces/underscores checked against a scratch org.
URL encoding evidence covers the strict local UTF-8 and ISO-8859-1 subset.
URL decoding evidence covers the strict local UTF-8 and ISO-8859-1 subset.
Decimal setScale evidence covers negative scale and directed rounding modes.
Decimal round evidence covers local HALF_UP tie behavior.
String split evidence covers Java regex quote escapes and positive limit handling.
